action.objective: Capture the black queen on d6, removing Black's strongest piece while our rook and bishop cover back-rank threats.
action.rationale: a3d6 (Qxd6) is the only commit_ready move: verified at depth 4, exact score 2875, safety complete (no immediate mate, tactical_refutation not_found). It immediately captures Black's queen for free — no recapture exists (opponent_captures_after empty) — and the queen becomes active on d6 with the black king on e8. Broad search's top alternative b2b4 was only an upper-bound score and would allow Qxb4, a clear material loss.
